messages:
Alex (PM): quick sync — thinking about a tiny experiment for DP onboarding: 3 nudges over first 7 days + a lightweight checklist. goal is reduce drop-off between signup -> first successful integration by 30%
Priya (Eng): +1. do we mean 'successful integration' as a hosted API call + model pin? or running a sample inference locally for private beta?
Alex (PM): good q. primary target = hosted flow (fastest metric), secondary = private deploys (we'll record separately). want one baseline for hosted to measure nudge effect.
Jordan (CS): can we instrument "first useful inference" as: 1) token generated, 2) schema validation passed for expected response? keeps it objective.
Sam (DevEx): I can add a small quickstart that auto-verifies schema. also add an opt-in initial survey after first inference to capture perceived accuracy. one-liner survey.
Marta (Product Ops): timeline wise we have a DP intake next Tue. can we have experiment ready to roll for a 2-week pilot window? need copy for nudges + tracking plan.
Priya (Eng): engineering estimate: add events + checklist page + one endpoint to flag completion ~ 3 dev-days. telemetry hooks another 1 day.
Alex (PM): ok aim for minimal: nudges = day0 (welcome + 1-click quickstart), day2 (how-to snippet + reminder), day6 (offer session with SE). if conversion improves we keep.
Jordan (CS): also propose variant B: replace day2 reminder with an example integration tailored to their stack (e.g., Node snippet vs Python). test signal whether example personalization beats generic reminder.
Marta (Product Ops): we'll need messaging templates for both generic and personalized. I'll draft CTAs and hand to Sam for quickstart copy.
Sam (DevEx): note: auth friction is biggest leak. recommend we detect failing auth attempts and send an inline tip nudge immediately (not waiting for scheduled day). low-effort alert.
Priya (Eng): we can emit "auth_failed" event and send immediate adaptive nudge. that should be straightforward. count it as part of the experiment.
Alex (PM): success metrics: primary = % users who hit 'first useful inference' within 7 days. secondary = NPS-ish survey after first inference, number of follow-on requests, and DP retention at 30 days. target: +30% primary, >= +0.2 NPS lift.
Jordan (CS): launch gates for wider DP rollout: 1) experiment shows statistically significant improvement (p<0.05) or 2) observed auth-fix reduces support tickets by 40% — whichever earlier. plus no regression on latency or cost.
Marta (Product Ops): tracking plan: cohort tags for DP vs non-DP, variant assignment (A=control, B=personalized examples, C=auth-adaptive). need instrumentation doc and dashboard.
Sam (DevEx): I'll build a small dashboard in Console: funnel (signup -> quickstart click -> first inference -> survey). ETA 4 days.
Priya (Eng): flag: for private deploys some nudges (like hosted quickstart) won't apply. we'll exclude private-DP from primary cohort. keep metrics segmented.
Alex (PM): good. action items: Priya send event schema + estimate this afternoon; Sam build quickstart + dashboard; Marta draft copy for nudges and SE session invite; Jordan define exact "useful inference" validation and sample eval queries. reconvene Fri 10am for preflight.
OpsBot: deploy-bot posted: rollout-checklist created for experiment on "dp-onboard-nudges". CI status: passing. :rocket:
Sam (DevEx): noted. pref sync Fri 10am. I'll post the preflight checklist here 24h before.
Alex (PM): thanks team. small ask for DP reps: when we invite partners for the pilot window, call out the short survey and optional SE session — transparency helps. :thumbsup:
